en: <CLT=cltMIND>I have training with Kaito now...

<CLT=cltMIND>He said the usual place.
I'll meet him in the courtyard.
<CLT=cltMIND>What to do...
<CLT=cltMIND>What can *I* do?

<CLT=cltMIND>The only thing I'm good at is solving
mysteries, but I can't figure out this academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't have many clues...
but that's no excuse.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>These monitors are everywhere,
but I don't see any cameras.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is the mastermind behind this
killing game monitoring us?

<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are we not really
being watched at all?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to rest in bed?
Free Time will end if you do.

<CLT=cltMIND>Panicking and worrying won't help
anything. I should rest...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>So many identical uniforms
in my closet...

<CLT=cltMIND>That kind of preparation must mean
that they were targeting us.
